name: Son Doong
summary: Do not add this after the boat cave. Oxalis runs it as six days and five nights, from January to August, and the Tourism Center does not sell a walk-up ticket. The pack generated on 17 Oct 2026 prints 3,000 USD, or 80,000,000 VND, a person. Be in Dong Hoi by 15:00 for the transfer and the compulsory briefing.
getThere: Dong Hoi by 15:00, then the briefing
heroCaption: A sunbeam in the first doline, with a person on the rock for scale

notice.title: Not a ticket at the pier
notice.body: Oxalis runs this trek. The boat-cave entrance does not include it. Miss the 15:00 arrival in Dong Hoi and you miss the compulsory briefing.

body: You camp in the cave. After the briefing, the trek leaves before 07:00 along Road 20 and the west Ho Chi Minh road. The operator’s route passes Hang En before you enter Son Doong. Groups are capped at 10. The park page puts the season at January to August and about 1,000 visitors a year.

What you see, when the light is there, is a doline with trees growing in the daylight, and a wall the park describes as 90 metres, climbed with ladders and ropes. The join-in pack prints both 3,000 USD and 80,000,000 VND a person. The age on that pack is 18 to 70. A private departure is a different price and was not copied. This is not a gate fee.
Skip it if you have a few days. The morning in the village is the boat. Paradise Cave is the dry walk, on its own ticket. This one takes the week.

figures.caption: The sandy floor inside the opening, on the way through the trek
figures.alt: A sandy floor and a stream inside a large cave opening at Son Doong

gettingThere: You do not start at the village pier. Oxalis wants you in Dong Hoi by 15:00 for the transfer to Phong Nha and the briefing that evening. The road minutes from the airport to that briefing are check on arrival.

legs.heading: From Dong Hoi
legs.body: Arrive by 15:00. The transfer to Phong Nha and the evening briefing are compulsory. The road minutes are check on arrival.

legs.heading: From Phong Nha village
legs.body: You sleep here after the briefing. The trek leaves before 07:00 the next morning, along Road 20 and the west Ho Chi Minh road. Minutes to the trailhead are check on arrival.

hours: January to August. Departures follow the operator calendar, not a daily gate.
closed: No walk-up entry. The pack does not run outside January to August.
admissionNote: Join-in group of 10. The Oxalis pack generated on 17 Oct 2026 prints 3,000 USD and 80,000,000 VND per person. Age 18 to 70. A private departure is a different price and was not copied. The park page confirms the operator, the months, the group cap, and about 1,000 visitors a year. It does not print the dollar figure.
